armor_perks.name: Player's Choice
armor_perks.description: Choose from any Armor Perk on this table.

armor_perks.name: EOD Layering
armor_perks.description: -20 Agility. Ignores Kill Radius damage increase from explosives. Ignores 10 Pierce from explosives. Cannot be concealed.

armor_perks.name: Flak Layering
armor_perks.description: -10 Agility. Halves Pierce from explosives. Cannot be concealed.

armor_perks.name: Fire Rescue
armor_perks.description: -10 Agility, Cannot catch fire. Vacuum Sealed for 10 Minutes of Oxygen. Half Damage from any Fire. Cannot be concealed.

armor_perks.name: Vacuum Sealed
armor_perks.description: The suit is vacuum sealed. 60 Minutes of Oxygen. Cannot be concealed.

armor_perks.name: Stab Vest
armor_perks.description: Halves Pierce from bladed weapons.

armor_perks.name: Padded Lining
armor_perks.description: Reduces Damage Roll by one Damage Dice from blunt, non-bladed melee Attacks.

armor_perks.name: Ballistics Layering
armor_perks.description: +2 Armor on all Locations against firearms.

armor_perks.name: Force Converter
armor_perks.description: When the User kills an Enemy with Explosive damage (must have Blast or Kill radius), the User will be given +3 Mythic Agility for 3 Turns. This may stack twice, for a total of +6.

armor_perks.name: Reactive Booster
armor_perks.description: If the User is affected by any temporary effect that debuffs them, they will gain +1 Mythic Agility for the duration of the debuff. This may stack up to 3 times for a total of +3 Mythic Agility from suffering 3 debuffs. A debuff is any effect that reduces a Characteristic or gives a Penalty of 10 or more for Tests.

armor_perks.name: Force Absorption
armor_perks.description: When the User kills an Enemy with Explosive Damage (must have Blast or Kill radius), the User will gain +4 Damage Resistance against Explosive Damage (Blast or Kill radius) for 4 Turns.

armor_perks.name: Laido
armor_perks.description: If the User Kills an Enemy the Turn after reloading a weapon, they will be healed for 3D10 Wounds.

armor_perks.name: Unfaltering Focus
armor_perks.description: When the User Kills an Enemy, they will gain +2 Damage Resistance for 4 Turns.

armor_perks.name: Absolution
armor_perks.description: Every time the User picks up an Orb of Light, they will gain an additional +5 Energy for that type.

armor_perks.name: Absorption Cells
armor_perks.description: While the User's Super Energy is full, Melee Weapons used with this Armor gain +1D10 Damage.

armor_perks.name: Grappler's Focus
armor_perks.description: When the User is in a Grapple, they will gain a temporary +4 Damage Resistance, which is ignored if the User is struck in the head. The Damage Resistance is lost when the User leaves the Grapple.

armor_perks.name: Adamantine Brace
armor_perks.description: Attacks with Charge (X) can be held indefinitely, allowing them to be fired at any time after the Charge Action.

armor_perks.name: Ascendant Protector
armor_perks.description: Gives the User +1 Disposition towards Guardian NPCs.

armor_perks.name: Ashes To Ashes
armor_perks.description: When the User kills an Enemy with a Grenade, they gain +10 Super Energy.

armor_perks.name: Rifle Dexterity
armor_perks.description: All Rifles carried by the User can be Quickdrawn, even if the User does not have the Ability or if the weapons are not in slings or holsters.

armor_perks.name: Shotgun Dexterity
armor_perks.description: All Shotguns carried by the User can be Quickdrawn, even if the User does not have the Ability or if the weapons are not in slings or holsters.

armor_perks.name: Melee Dexterity
armor_perks.description: All Melee Weapons carried by the User can be Quickdrawn, even if the User does not have the Ability or if the weapons are not in slings or holsters.

armor_perks.name: Launcher Dexterity
armor_perks.description: All Launchers carried by the User can be Quickdrawn, even if the User does not have the Ability or if the weapons are not in slings or holsters.

armor_perks.name: Fusion Dexterity
armor_perks.description: All Fusion Rifles and Linear Fusion Rifles carried by the User can be Quickdrawn, even if the User does not have the Ability or if the weapons are not in slings or holsters.

armor_perks.name: Pistol Dexterity
armor_perks.description: All Hand Cannons, Sidearms, and SMGs carried by the User can be Quickdrawn, even if the User does not have the Ability or if the weapons are not in slings or holsters.

armor_perks.name: Auto-Reserves
armor_perks.description: This Armor allows the User to carry 1 additional Dust Ammunition of each kind.

armor_perks.name: Auto-Targeting
armor_perks.description: When the User makes an Aim Action, they will gain an additional +5 Bonus To Hit.

armor_perks.name: Battle-Hearth
armor_perks.description: If an Enemy that the User Damaged is killed by an Ally, the User gains +5 Super Energy.

armor_perks.name: Biotic Enhancement
armor_perks.description: The User gains +1 Melee Reach to Unarmed Melee Attacks.

armor_perks.name: Bomber
armor_perks.description: Explosives from the User's Light Abilities and weapons gain +1 to their Blast radius.

armor_perks.name: Bring The Heat
armor_perks.description: Light Ability Grenades will gain Flame (1). If they already have Flame (X), it gains +1.

armor_perks.name: Cryo King
armor_perks.description: Light Ability Grenades will gain Cryo (1). If they already have Cryo (X), it gains +1.

armor_perks.name: Cauterizing Flame
armor_perks.description: When the User's Wounds first go under 25% in Combat, create a 2 meter radius pillar of flame. Any Enemy that walks into the Pillar will take Flame (2) Special Rule.

armor_perks.name: Chaotic Exchanger
armor_perks.description: While the User's Light Energy is half or lower, the Armor gains +2 on all Locations.

armor_perks.name: Clenched Fist
armor_perks.description: Successfully Parrying a Melee Attack will heal the User 1D5 Wounds.

armor_perks.name: Hefty
armor_perks.description: The Armor gains +1 Armor on the Chest and Leg Locations.

armor_perks.name: Hard-Hat
armor_perks.description: The Armor gains +1 Armor on the Head Location.

armor_perks.name: Concussive Dampener
armor_perks.description: The Armor reduces Damage taken by explosives (Blast and Kill) by ignoring the last Damage Dice rolled for its Damage.

armor_perks.name: Cross Counter
armor_perks.description: When the User uses a Light Ability, their next Melee Attack will gain +1D10 Damage.

armor_perks.name: Dire Artillery
armor_perks.description: When the User's Grenade kills an Enemy, the User will regain 5 Super Energy.

armor_perks.name: Distribution
armor_perks.description: When the User picks up an Orb of Light, they will regain 5 of the other type of Energy. Light will give Super Energy , and Super will give Light Energy.

armor_perks.name: Double Dodge
armor_perks.description: The User's first Evasion Test does not give Penalties to later Reactions each Turn.

armor_perks.name: Fastball
armor_perks.description: The User's Throw Distance is increased by 10 meters.

armor_perks.name: Font of Light
armor_perks.description: Killing an Enemy will spawn an Orb of Light that offers no initial effects, but will activate Perks that make use of them.

armor_perks.name: Primary Ammo Finder
armor_perks.description: When a Primary Dust Ammunition drops, an additional one will drop for the User.

armor_perks.name: Special Ammo Finder
armor_perks.description: When a Special Dust Ammunition drops, an additional one will drop for the User.

armor_perks.name: Heavy Ammo Finder
armor_perks.description: When a Heavy Dust Ammunition drops, an additional one will drop for the User.

armor_perks.name: Heavy Lifting
armor_perks.description: Every successful Melee Attack made regains 1 Super Energy.

armor_perks.name: Impact Induction
armor_perks.description: Every successful Melee Attack made regains 1 Light Energy.

armor_perks.name: Innervation
armor_perks.description: When the User picks up an Orb of Light, they will regain 5 Light Energy.

armor_perks.name: Primary Arms Reserves
armor_perks.description: The User can carry 2 additional Primary Dust Ammunitions.

armor_perks.name: Special Arms Reserves
armor_perks.description: The User can carry 2 additional Special Dust Ammunitions.

armor_perks.name: Heavy Arms Reserves
armor_perks.description: The User can carry 2 additional Heavy Dust Ammunitions.

armor_perks.name: Light Reactor
armor_perks.description: Killed Enemies will regain 1 Super Energy.

armor_perks.name: Major Resist
armor_perks.description: If an Attack would leave the User unconscious, it will instead leave them at 1 Wound. This can only happen once per Combat.

armor_perks.name: Minor Resist
armor_perks.description: Attacks from Enemies will do 1 less Damage.

armor_perks.name: Outreach
armor_perks.description: Melee Attacks gain +1 Melee Reach.

armor_perks.name: Pistoleer
armor_perks.description: Kills made with Sidearms and Hand Cannons regain 2 Super Energy.

armor_perks.name: Plasteel Reinforcement
armor_perks.description: The Armor gains +1 on each Location.

armor_perks.name: Pump Action
armor_perks.description: Kills made with Shotguns regain 2 Super Energy.

armor_perks.name: Recuperation
armor_perks.description: Any time the User picks up an Orb of Light, they are healed 1 Wound.

armor_perks.name: Restitution
armor_perks.description: Any time the User is healed, they generate an Orb of Light that only allies can interact with. These Orbs of Light will heal the Allies 1 Wound when picked up.

armor_perks.name: Remote Connection
armor_perks.description: Kills made with Sniper Rifles regain 2 Super Energy.

armor_perks.name: Rifleman
armor_perks.description: Kills made with Rifles and SMGs (Sniper Rifles excluded) regain 2 Super Energy.

armor_perks.name: Roughneck
armor_perks.description: Kills made with Launcher weapons regain 2 Super Energy.

armor_perks.name: Scatter Projectile Targeting
armor_perks.description: Weapons with Auto, Burst, and Spread Special Rule gain a +5 Bonus To Hit.

armor_perks.name: Snapmare
armor_perks.description: Weapons with the Semi-Auto and Sustained Rate of Fire gain a +5 Bonus To Hit.

armor_perks.name: Serenity
armor_perks.description: The Close Range of all weapons used is increased by 10 meters.

armor_perks.name: Storm of Lead
armor_perks.description: Ranged Weapons of the User gain +50% Magazine when Reloaded. This is lost on the next Reload.

armor_perks.name: The Dance
armor_perks.description: When making a successful Evasion Test, the next Evasion Test is only at a -5 Penalty instead of the normal -10 Penalty.

armor_perks.name: The Whispers
armor_perks.description: Successful Melee Attacks will give the next Melee Attack made a +4 to Damage.

armor_perks.name: Tight Fit
armor_perks.description: When the User successfully Evades an Attack, their active Weapon's Reload is reduced by 1. This does not stack.

armor_perks.name: Traction
armor_perks.description: The User increases their Agility Modifier by 2 when figuring Run and Sprint Speeds.

armor_perks.name: Transfusion Matrix
armor_perks.description: Successful Kills from Unarmed Melee Attacks will heal the User 2D10 Wounds.

armor_perks.name: Unflinching
armor_perks.description: The User won't be knocked out of Aim Actions when taking Damage, unless they are thrown from Explosives.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Player's Choice
exotic_armor_perks.description: Choose from any Armor Perk on this table.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Bring The Heat
exotic_armor_perks.description: Grenades thrown will explode on impact and the User's Throw distance is doubled. Kills with Grenades will give the User +10 Light Energy.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Aeon Energy
exotic_armor_perks.description: When a Grenade Light Ability is used, all allies within 10 meters will gain the following benefit based on their Class. These effects can't stack from multiple uses and does not effect the User. Warlocks: +2D10 Damage for their next Grenade Light Ability used. Titans: +1D10 Damage to the next Half Action of Melee Attacks. Hunters: +20 Bonus to Evasion Tests.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Alchemical Etchings
exotic_armor_perks.description: Any Rift or Void spawned through the User's Light Abilities will have an additional effect: You and any Ally who enters or passes through the Rift will have all Reload Speeds on all weapons halved, rounding down, for 2 Turns.

exotic_armor_perks.name: And Another Thing
exotic_armor_perks.description: When the User of this Armor uses a Grenade Light Ability, they will gain access to a second Grenade that can be used within 4 Turns or until the Grenade Light Ability is activated again.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Scavenging Synthesis
exotic_armor_perks.description: Any time the User would pick up an Dust Ammunition, they will gain a second of that kind.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Better Already
exotic_armor_perks.description: When the User picks up an Orb of Light, they will be healed 2D10 Wounds.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Beyond The Veil
exotic_armor_perks.description: Every 6 Turns, the User will gain a Smoke Grenade. This Smoke Grenade can be thrown down as a Half Action, creating a flash of light and smoke, giving any Enemy within 10 meters a -20 Penalty To Hit the User or any Ally for 1 Turn.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Blastwave Striders
exotic_armor_perks.description: The User halves the Damage taken from their own Explosives (Blast and Kill radius Attacks) before Damage Resistance is figured. By propelling themselves with one of their own Explosives, the User will multiply their Jump or Leap Action based on the amount of D10s the explosive's Damage.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Blessing Of Order
exotic_armor_perks.description: Whenever the User is healed by a Light Ability, they create a Shard. This Shard will strike the nearest Enemy within 40 meters, dealing 1D10 Damage ignoring Damage Resistance. Only one is created per Half Action.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Cerebral Uplink
exotic_armor_perks.description: The first instance of something regenerating or adding to the User's Light Energy will be doubled. At the end of the User's Turn, the Armor will give +5 Light Energy.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Dreaded Visage
exotic_armor_perks.description: Any time the User of this Armor takes Damage to their Wounds, they will regain Light Energy equal to the amount of Damage they took.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Dynamo
exotic_armor_perks.description: The User's Super Light Ability takes 10 less Super Energy to use.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Embers of Light
exotic_armor_perks.description: When the User casts a Light Ability, they are healed 2 Wounds and the next Light Ability they Cast within 3 Turns will gain +50% to all numerical stats, such as Damage, Duration, And Special Rule (X).

exotic_armor_perks.name: Feast of Light
exotic_armor_perks.description: If the User's Super Energy is at its max of 100 and they pick up an Orb of Light, the Armor will regenerate 10 Shield Integrity.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Firewalker
exotic_armor_perks.description: When the User kills an Enemy, their weapon will gain the Flame (1) Special Rule for the next Half Action of Attacks.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Fervid Coldsnap
exotic_armor_perks.description: When the User kills an Enemy, their weapon will gain the Cryo (1) Special Rule for the next Half Action of Attacks.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Force Multiplier
exotic_armor_perks.description: Weapons with the Spread Special Rule will gain an additional +1D10 Damage in Close Range. Kills with Shotguns will give the User +5 Light Energy.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Fury Conductors
exotic_armor_perks.description: Successful Melee Attacks will regain 5 Light Energy. When the User is struck by a Melee Attack that deals Damage to their Wounds, they will gain +5 Damage Resistance for 1 Turn. Once every 5 Turns, when the User is struck by a Melee Attack, they will create a Blast (4) effect that deals 1D10 Damage to all Enemies, ignoring Damage Resistance.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Grenade Harness
exotic_armor_perks.description: All Grenades gain +1D10 Damage when thrown by the User. When the thrown Grenade kills an Enemy, it will regenerate 10 Light Energy for the User.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Glacial Fortification
exotic_armor_perks.description: When the User creates any type of Barrier that has a Shield Integrity or stops incoming Damage that strikes it, a radius effect will emanate outward from the barrier. All enemies within 3 meters of these barriers will have their Movement Speeds halved.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Glorious Charge
exotic_armor_perks.description: This Armor increases the Damage of Charge Melee Attacks by +2D10. If this Kills an Enemy, the Armor regenerates 10 Shield Integrity.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Halberdier's Reach
exotic_armor_perks.description: When the User is outnumbered in Melee Combat, the User gains +2 Melee Reach and +1D10 Damage.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Hammer of the Gods
exotic_armor_perks.description: When the User makes a Melee Attack with a weapon and strikes a Target, all Enemies within a 4 meter radius of that Targeted Enemy will be struck by a bolt of lightning. This will deal 1D10 Damage, ignoring Damage Resistance.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Hearts of Ice
exotic_armor_perks.description: Any type of shockwave, blast, or radius Damaging effect created by a Light Ability gains the Cryo (1D10) Special Rule.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Helium Spirals
exotic_armor_perks.description: Any Grenade Ability that has a duration that its effects, Damage, or Special Rules last will last an additional Half Action.

exotic_armor_perks.name: High Priority
exotic_armor_perks.description: When a weapon is holstered, it will automatically reload after 3 Turns.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Hydraulic Boosters
exotic_armor_perks.description: The User gains +2 Mythic Agility.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Illegally Modded Holster
exotic_armor_perks.description: When a weapon is used alongside a Quickdraw and is then fired, the first Attack made by the weapon gains +1D10 Damage, gains the Kinetic Special Rule, and will strike on the lowest Armor of the Target.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Insulation
exotic_armor_perks.description: Whenever the User casts a Super Light Ability, they are healed for 2D5 Wounds.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Jump Jets
exotic_armor_perks.description: The User's Jump and Leap distances are doubled, including the distances traveled with Jump-based Light Abilities.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Kintsugi
exotic_armor_perks.description: Once per Turn when the User kills an Enemy, a healing Rift will be created around them with a 2 meter radius. This Rift will last for 2 Turns and will heal everyone standing inside 1D5 Wounds per Half Action.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Light Shift
exotic_armor_perks.description: Whenever the User makes a successful Evasion Test, they can choose to move 1 meter in any direction they can normally travel to on foot. This will not stop all of the incoming Attacks within the same Half Action of being fired from striking, even if this is used to move behind Cover.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Linear Actuators
exotic_armor_perks.description: The User increases their Agility Modifier by 3 when figuring Run and Sprint Movement Speeds.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Move To Survive
exotic_armor_perks.description: All Universal Movement Abilities will travel 50% farther, rounding down, to a minimum of +1 meter.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Myrmidon's Reach
exotic_armor_perks.description: Thrown Melee Weapons will gain the Kinetic Special Rule.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Nightmare Fuel
exotic_armor_perks.description: Dealing 10 or more Melee Damage with a single Attack will reload the User's most recently used, holstered weapon.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Null Factor
exotic_armor_perks.description: When a Light Ability is used that creates a Melee Weapon or modifies a Melee Attack of any kind, the Light Energy used to create this is halved.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Parting Gift
exotic_armor_perks.description: A successful Evade Into Cover will leave behind an explosion with a 2 meter radius. Any Enemy within that explosion will take 3D10 Damage.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Percussive Flames
exotic_armor_perks.description: If a Light Ability or Weapon being used has the Flame Special Rule, it will be increased by 3.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Peregrine Strike
exotic_armor_perks.description: When the User makes a Charge Melee Attack, it gains the Kinetic Special Rule.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Rapid Cooldown
exotic_armor_perks.description: At the end of the User's Turn, they will regain 10 Light Energy if a Movement Action of any kind was made.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Reflective Vents
exotic_armor_perks.description: When a Universal Movement Ability is used, the next Attack that strikes the User will be deflected. This can't be used to deflect Damage from radius Attacks, such as the Blast and Kill radius, shockwaves, and Rifts.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Relentless Tracker
exotic_armor_perks.description: When the User views an Enemy while making an Aim Action, they will be Marked for 3 Turns. The User gains a +30 Bonus to Oppose a Marked Enemy's Camouflage. Marked Enemies who are at half or less total Wounds will take 4 extra Damage from all sources of Damage.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Resolute
exotic_armor_perks.description: When the User makes use of any Light Ability that creates a Melee Weapon or increases Melee Damage, their Armor's Shield Integrity will be increased by 20 for 2 Turns. This can't stack with other instances of Resolute.

exotic_armor_perks.name: See Me, Feel Me
exotic_armor_perks.description: After using a Light Ability that makes the User invisible, the next Attack made by the User gains +2D10 Damage.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Seriously, Watch Out
exotic_armor_perks.description: When the User makes a Run or Sprint Movement Action, the Armor's Shield Integrity regenerates up to 20 missing Integrity.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Sharp Edges
exotic_armor_perks.description: If the User's Super Light Ability strikes and Damages any Enemy, 10 Super Energy will be refunded at the end of the Turn.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Vengeance
exotic_armor_perks.description: Any Enemy who Damages the User will glow yellow for 2 Turns. If they are killed while glowing, the User or Ally who kills them will regenerate up to 50 of their Shield Integrity.

exotic_armor_perks.name: Wraithmetal Mail
exotic_armor_perks.description: When the User successfully Evades an Attack, any empty magazine weapons on the User will be instantly reloaded.
